item.title: NVIDIA's Jetson Thor Is Impressive
item.description:
Intro

NVIDIA recently released the Jetson Thor, their latest state-of-the-art chip in their Jetson line of products. It’s impressive enough that it has awoken me from my slumber long enough to do a brief overview of its capabilities. Following the trend of its predecessors, Jetson Thor is marketed as an entire platform aimed at bringing interactive artificial intelligence into the physical plane.
